title: Enterprise Integration Patterns — Entra ID ↔ Google + M365 Coexistence + Third-Party Apps
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: One consistent way to connect Google, Microsoft, and everything else
problem: During and after a Google transformation, authentication, authorization, and data access must stay consistent across Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace, the legacy Microsoft systems in coexistence, and third-party enterprise apps (ServiceNow, SAP, Databricks, and more). This solution defines the enterprise integration patterns — the reference designs for identity federation, provisioning, app SSO, and data access — so integrations are consistent, secure, and don't become a pile of one-off connections.
whats_inside: Integration Overview — the pattern catalog approach: identity federation, provisioning, app SSO/OIDC/SAML, API/data-access, and coexistence, and how each maps to Entra + Google.

Reference Patterns — Entra ID ↔ Google (federation + provisioning), M365-during-coexistence, and third-party apps (ServiceNow, SAP, Databricks, etc.) with the recommended authN/authZ and data-access approach for each.
Standards & Anti-Patterns — the consistent approach to authentication, authorization, and data access, plus the anti-patterns (per-app snowflakes, credential sprawl) to avoid.

5 supporting scripts — integration-inventory discovery (SSO apps, provisioning, federation), pattern-conformance validation, an integration coverage/exception report, safe remediation guidance, and a scope helper.
Testing gates + an Integration-Patterns reference doc and Best Practices for a consolidated, standards-based integration estate.
short: Define the enterprise integration patterns across Entra ID ↔ Google, M365 coexistence, and third-party apps (ServiceNow/SAP/Databricks) — consistent authentication, authorization, and data access, not one-off connections. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Define the enterprise integration patterns across Entra ID ↔ Google, M365 coexistence, and third-party apps (ServiceNow/SAP/Databricks) — consistent authentication, authorization, and data access, not one-off connections.
meta_title: Enterprise Integration Patterns — Entra ID ↔ Google + Third-Party Apps
meta_description: Define consistent integration patterns for a Google transformation: Entra ID ↔ Google federation/provisioning, M365 coexistence, and third-party apps (ServiceNow, SAP, Databricks) with standard authN/authZ and data access. Self-guided patterns and scripts.
bottom_line: Consistent, standards-based integration across Google, Microsoft, and third-party apps — stable identity and data access, no snowflake connections — that scales through the transformation and beyond.
